headline: Amanta Healthcare submits insider trading disclosures
hook: Insider trading disclosure filed by Amanta
summary: Amanta Healthcare Limited has filed disclosures as required under Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. This regulation mandates that promoters, directors, and employees report changes in their shareholding to the company and the stock exchange. Such filings are standard procedural requirements for listed entities to ensure transparency in insider transactions.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
